---
title: "[قواعد كتابة الهمزة]{.aralt}"
format:
  html:
    mainfont: "CharisW"
    mainfontoptions: Numbers=OldStyle
    sansfont: "CharisW"
    monofont: "DejaVu Sans Mono" # set size in CSS using class "sourceCode"
    theme:
      - cosmo # body text is a little grey which is good.
      - srchtml/custom.scss
    css: srchtml/styles.css
    linkcolor: "hsl(210,10.3448275862%,47.7450980392%)" # obtained by inspecting webpage
    toc-title: "[الفهرست]{.aralt}"
    # background color. see also srchtml/custom.scss
    backgroundcolor: "#FDFBF7" # ultra light ivory
  pdf:
    #keep-tex: true
    documentclass: scrreprt # no roman numeral pagination but chapter page can be left or right
    #toc: true
    #toc-depth: 2
    #toc-title: Contents
    number-sections: true
    colorlinks: true
    mainfont: "Charis"
    mainfontoptions:
      - Numbers=OldStyle
      - BoldFont="Charis SemiBold"
    sansfont: "Charis"
    sansfontoptions:
      - Numbers=OldStyle
      - BoldFont="Charis SemiBold"
    monofont: "DejaVu Sans Mono"
    monofontoptions: "Scale=0.7"
    fontsize: 10pt
    #indent: true # indent first line of paragraph. Also seems to disable extra paragraph vertical spacing.
    #pdf-engine: xelatex
    #include-in-header:
    #  - file: srctex/include_in_header.tex
    #include-before-body:
    #  - file: srctex/before_body.tex
    template-partials:
      - srctex/before-title.tex
    #block-headings: false



filters:
  - arabic-support
  - filters/footnotesize.lua
  - filters/citex.lua

---
::: {.aralt}
بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

:::
